<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that converts the given product (an aldehyde with an aliphatic hydroxyl) back to a carboxylic ester, matching the DIBAL‑H reduction forward reaction (ester → aldehyde + aliphatic hydroxyl). Use the product SMILES from the provided data and the appropriate functional group names.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
